moments.title: Strictly's First Live Dance-Off
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing begins its live competitive shows this Saturday, following last weekend's launch.

angles.name: Pre-show buzz
angles.copy: Who are you backing for the Glitterball? The Strictly Come Dancing live shows kick off this Saturday, and we're ready for the sequins to fly!

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are ready to rumble. What do you make of the new Strictly era?

moments.title: Nigella Lawson Joins Bake Off
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off Series 17 launched this week with Nigella Lawson making her debut as a new judge, sparking conversation among viewers.

angles.name: New Judge Reaction
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is in the Bake Off tent! Did you catch her judging debut and what did you think of the new flavour she brings?

angles.name: Baking Craze
angles.copy: The Bake Off tent is open for business! Who's inspired to get baking after seeing the new series with Nigella Lawson?

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The UK Official Singles Chart will be updated this Friday, revealing the new top-selling tracks after Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' held the top spot for two weeks.

angles.name: Chart Prediction
angles.copy: Who's going to seize the top spot? The new UK Singles Chart drops this Friday! Any predictions for number one?

angles.name: Current #1
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro has had a 'Great Expectation' at #1 for two weeks! Can they make it three or will someone new take the crown on Friday?

moments.title: Women's Champions League Action

angles.name: Chelsea UWCL
angles.copy: It's Women's Champions League Matchday 1 and Chelsea are playing today! Tune in to support the Blues in European action.

angles.name: European Football
angles.copy: European football for the women's teams is back! Who are you cheering for in the UEFA Women's Champions League?
